title: EUNICE MOOCs (Massive Open Online Courses)
description: Free, asynchronous, self-paced online courses (MOOCs) run by EUNICE, a European university alliance, on global studies/soft-skills and sustainable-development/marine-ecosystem topics. Explicitly does not require enrollment at any EUNICE partner university to take a course.
selectivity_evidence: Open enrollment, no selection process found; selectivity_tier not claimed above open_enrollment.
verification_status: Verified - official EUNICE courses page fetched directly, 2026-08-22. All currently listed course editions show 'Applications closed' with no next window announced.
notes: Every specific course edition checked is currently closed (one had a stated access window through 2025-12-19, already elapsed) with no next cohort date published anywhere found -- recorded as a real, recurring program (cycle_status=date_not_announced, deadline=null) rather than fabricating a 2026/2027 date. High-school eligibility is NOT explicitly confirmed: the page says the MOOCs are 'open to anyone interested' and don't require university enrollment, which is suggestive but not a stated age/education-level floor -- flagging the ambiguity rather than asserting 14-18 fit. No Turkey partner institution found among EUNICE's alliance members in anything fetched; this is a Europe-general (EU university-alliance), not Turkey-specific, fill. SOURCE-AUTHORITY: domain eunice-university.eu does not match looksOfficial()'s .edu/.ac./.gov suffix rules (plain .eu) -- fifth of six organiser domains in this whole pass to fail the gate; only brookes.ac.uk (academic_program) has passed so far.
